description: Install an Operator on the OpenShift/Kubernetes cluster using OLM, Helm, or direct manifests

channel.description: Update channel for the operator (stable, alpha, beta, etc.)

createNamespace.description: Create namespace if it does not exist

helmRepo.description: Helm repository URL (required if source is helm)

installPlanApproval.description: Install plan approval strategy for OLM

manifestUrl.description: URL to operator manifest (required if source is manifest)

operatorName.description: Name of the operator to install (e.g., "prometheus-operator", "cert-manager")

source.description: Installation method: olm (Operator Lifecycle Manager), helm (Helm chart), or manifest (direct YAML)

version.description: Version of the operator to install (if not specified, installs latest available)

name: oc_install_operator
